lake.scope: Selected Natural Earth lake source and baseline geometries only.
lake.source_attribution: Natural Earth 5.0.0 1:10m lake data, as attributed by the pinned Pando manifest and original feature properties. Made with Natural Earth.
lake.short_excerpt: All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the public domain.
lake.interpretation: The retained official terms place all versions of Natural Earth vector/raster data in the public domain and permit modification and electronic dissemination. Only the selected lake features are retained here.
lake.exclusions: No rights assertion is made for unrelated documents or maps. Full upstream assets and decoder dependencies are not republished.

river.license_access: Official PDF text was read through web extraction. Original PDF download returned HTTP 403 and was not retried. No complete PDF-byte checksum is claimed.
river.finding: HydroRIVERS points to the HydroSHEDS license. It allows specified derivative use and distribution subject to protective end-user terms and attribution, and restricts stand-alone distribution. Open redistribution of a selected GeoJSON has not been established.
river.public_package_scope: Own factual findings, identifiers, bounded coordinate facts, counts, hashes, citations and offline validation code. No complete coordinate arrays, binary packs, raw source maps or third-party documents.
